description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.9.0. It contains methods to create and modify database schema elements such as tables, columns, and menu items, as well as inserting initial data such as themes and permissions related to corporate branding.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class handling database schema migrations for OrangeHRM version 4.9.0, including creation of tables, columns, and insertion of default data related to themes, menu items, and permissions.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the schema migration, creating tables and columns if they do not exist, inserting default themes, permissions, menu items, and setting up internationalization groups.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, in this case '4.9'.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper function to insert new menu items into the menu hierarchy in the database.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Helper function to insert a theme with specified variables into the database.
